description: This file defines an interface for access to retry configuration settings within the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically within the Retry namespace. It declares methods to retrieve retry mode, maximum attempts, and configuration as an array.

classes.name: ConfigurationInterface
classes.description: Interface providing access to retry configuration in the AWS SDK.

methods.name: getMode
methods.description: Returns the retry mode, such as 'legacy', 'standard', or 'adaptive'.

methods.name: getMaxAttempts
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of retry attempts for a request.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns the configuration as an associative array.
